description: The state of an AgentRun created by the released docker-agent provider v0.1.1 (pulumi stack export --show-secrets of a local-backend stack, `pulumi up` against a fake model server). TestAgentRunUpgradeFromV011 checks that v0.1.2 neither diffs nor reruns it.

providers:

    api_type: openai_chatcompletions

models:
  m:
    provider: fake
    model: fake-model
agents:
  root:
    model: m
    description: Test agent
